modes.name: Code Reviewer
modes.description: 只读代码审查：按阻塞/建议/打磨分级输出问题清单，条条引用 file:line。Read-only review with severity-ranked findings, each citing file:line.
modes.author: eeyzs1

modes.name: Commit Scribe
modes.description: 看真实 git status/diff 起草 conventional commit，正文讲 why 不讲 what，语言跟随仓库历史。Drafts conventional commits from real git status/diff, why-focused body, language follows repo history.
modes.author: eeyzs1

modes.name: Test Writer
modes.description: 为源码补 vitest 单测：真实行为回环、只在系统边界 mock、跑通为止。Writes vitest unit tests with real behavior loops, boundary-only mocks, runs them until green.
modes.author: eeyzs1

modes.name: Doc Writer
modes.description: 为导出符号与非显然逻辑补文档注释，只写注释不改行为。Adds doc comments to exported symbols and non-obvious logic; comments only, zero behavior change.
modes.author: eeyzs1

modes.name: Refactor Advisor
modes.description: 只读重构顾问：先查调用点再下判断，输出小步有序计划与 before/after 草图。Read-only advisor: checks call sites first, delivers an ordered plan of small behavior-preserving steps with before/after sketches.
modes.author: eeyzs1
